source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes—and in addition, I want to make sure the Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley locations stay separate, with each location having its own payouts, calendar, and revenue tracking.

value_updates.payout_isolation: Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley must each have their own payouts

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Under the Wix setup, one website uses a single payment account, so it wouldn’t support different payout accounts for each location. Bookings, calendars, and reporting can still be managed separately by location, but the payouts would go through the same payment account.

ambiguity.description: The single-website Wix setup cannot support the client-required separate payout accounts, so the payout architecture requires a client decision.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Selecting a location like Ridgehaven or Harbor Valley will take the visitor to that location’s own Wix website, where bookings and payment processing will occur. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

value_updates.payout_setup: Each location uses its own Wix website, Wix account, and payment setup to support separate payouts
